exploit_name: Wide-range short legs revert solvency checks due to invalid tick
description: In-range interpolation calls getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper - tickLower), which fails for ranges exceeding 887,272 ticks.
attack_scenario: Create wide short (tickUpper - tickLower > 1M). Wait for tick to enter range. Liquidation reverts on margin calculation.
root_cause: In-range interpolation calls getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper - tickLower), which fails for ranges exceeding 887,272 ticks.
fix_description: Compute ratio from individual endpoints: sqrtRatio = getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper) * FP96 / getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickLower).
notes: Deterministic solvency check failures block liquidation, enabling insolvent-but-unliquidatable accounts.
